correctness.rationale: The independently specified 10-vertex graph and connected-triple forbidden model yield all 230 faces. Certificate contains 109 disjoint legal pairs and 12 critical simplices (one vertex, eleven 3-simplices). Reversed matching orientation is topologically sorted across all 710 covering relations, establishing acyclicity; Morse CW theorem proves integral wedge of 11 S3. Independent component-based enumeration and signed twenty-element Lefschetz/coset checks prove the rational representation.

value.rationale: The pentagonal prism is the first genuinely odd five-rung cyclic ladder beyond the triangular prism and a canonical cubic graph. The first higher-independence homotopy type differs from the previously classified ordinary independence circle and odd-rung contractible perfect matching complex. The complete rational D5 x C2 symmetry module and its two invariant classes are mathematically motivated distinctions beyond mere Betti numbers, useful as a natural base case for investigating higher independence of ladder families.
